name: MuslimInk
author: fiqsr
changelog_id: Peningkatan Kecepatan & Responsivitas Keyboard: Pengetikan pada keyboard virtual E-ink di tab Doa kini instan tanpa lag dengan render tombol langsung dan efek sorot tombol yang diketuk

Mesin Pencari Doa Cerdas Multi-Token: Pencarian doa ala Google mendukung kata kunci majemuk, pencocokan awalan, sinonim dwibahasa (sholat/prayer, tidur/sleep, makan/food, sakit/sick), dan pemeringkatan relevansi
Menu Pengaturan Penyimpanan & Cache Baru: Tambahan opsi di Pengaturan untuk hapus cache berkas doa, sinkronisasi katalog 227 doa via GitHub, dan reset bookmark doa tersimpan
Tampilan UI Rapi & Bebas Terpotong: Seluruh judul doa, pill kategori, dan sumber/hadits kini otomatis dibungkus multi-baris rapi tanpa terpotong atau keluar batas
Migrasi Dwibahasa Otomatis untuk Doa Terunduh: Deteksi otomatis teks terjemahan campuran/lama pada doa unduhan saat berganti bahasa serta opsi pembersihan sekali klik
changelog_en: High-Speed Virtual Keyboard Responsiveness: Keystroke responsiveness in the Doa tab is now instantaneous with direct hardware rect rendering and tactile tap highlight feedback

Smart Multi-Token Google-Style Search: Supplication search now supports multi-word queries, token prefix matching, rich bilingual synonyms (prayer/sholat, sleep/tidur, food/makan), and relevance ranking
Dedicated Storage & Cache Management: New Settings screen row allowing 1-tap cache clearance, GitHub 227-prayer catalog synchronization, and bookmark resetting
Perfect UI Layout & Zero Truncation: Category pills, supplication titles, and hadith references now wrap gracefully across multiple lines with clean borders and no clipping
Bilingual Auto-Migration for Downloaded Prayers: Automatic re-fetch and language switching for cached prayer files ensuring consistent English or Indonesian text
